reason: This looks like a compensation/AC-shaping capacitor; the core DC differential amplification path does not depend on it. Removing it typically preserves basic functionality but changes stability, bandwidth, and transient response.
impact_estimate: Low for DC/operating-point; Medium for AC/transient (possible peaking/oscillation depending on loading and feedback).

reason: R2 appears to provide a DC reference/leak path for the C0 auxiliary node (net44). If C0 is removed, net44 becomes unused, so R2 can also be removed with essentially no effect on the amplifier core.
impact_estimate: Negligible if C0 is also removed; otherwise Low-to-Medium (could leave net44 floating and affect AC behavior).

reason: R3 is a shunt load on the output; it is not required for the differential pair and active-load mechanism to operate. Deleting it mainly reduces output loading, increasing gain/output swing, but may make the output more sensitive to leakage or downstream floating loads.
impact_estimate: Low for core operation; Low-to-Medium for output biasing/loading (depends on whether another load/feedback provides a DC path at VOUT1).
